notes.title: v1.16 notes
notes.content:
- The Main Menu background has been changed, as AMD users were unable to render the previous animated background correctly. This time, the background is much richer—still animated, but now in 3D.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hhqhOoF.jpeg[/img]

- Fixed a bug where users with a 4:3 screen could get abnormally high scores. Only a couple of scores had to be removed.

notes.title: Minor hotfix
notes.content:
After a minor update yesterday, a small bug was introduced, causing some users to upload their scores with a GPU name missing its VRAM capacity. As a result, those scores were not included in the averages and were considered as different GPU models.

Unfortunately, those [b]few scores had to be removed[/b]. If you noticed your score appearing on the leaderboards without the VRAM capacity next to your GPU name, it was affected.

The bug [b]has now been fixed[/b] and you can re-run your tests if you’d like to contribute to the leaderboards again.

[b]Apologies[/b] for the inconvenience and thank you for understanding.

notes.title: v1.15 notes. "Free-to-use + DLC" approach
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Raster leaderboards
[*] New leaderboard organization: always one leaderboard on screen, with its associated "Top Players" leaderboard. Changing the resolution in the menu settings will switch between leaderboards. Additionally, changing the benchmark mode will now switch the shown leaderboard to the matching one.
[*] Improved how the leaderboards are managed, making it faster and more reliable.
[*] Scores below 160 points are now ignored, as they were indicative of not reaching the minimum measurable threshold.
[*] Many small changes to adapt it to the new approach, already live: free-to-play + Pro DLC.
[*] Free users will now contribute by uploading their scores to the leaderboards database.
[*] Free users will now have some free Pro usage days: the 1st and 15th of each month (subject to change).
[*] Updated with a new Unreal Engine hotfix version.
[/list]

notes.title: A new approach is coming soon (Free-to-play + paid DLC)
notes.content:
The [b]concept will remain the same[/b]: a limited free version (previously known as the Demo) and a paid "PRO" version with all the extra features, just as always.


This is the idea, unless you have something to say! Feedback is always welcome. The [b]users' comfort is our priority[/b]:
[list][*] The game will [b]still have a Free version and a PRO version[/b], just as before, and [b]current paid owners will still own the PRO[/b] version. You won't lose it.
[*] The "schema" will change from "[i]Limited Demo + PRO base game[/i]" to "[i]Free-to-play limited game + Pro DLC[/i]", but keeping the [b]same features and concept: Free + Paid[/b].
[*] Both Free and Pro versions will be able to receive updates at the same time, more unified in general.
[*] Currently, Free users' scores are discarded due to a Steam limitation. With the upcoming approach, [u][b]Free users' scores will enrich the leaderboards[/b][/u].
[*] It will be easier to add future scenes as additional DLCs.
[*] The Free version will be a little more complete, as detailed below.[/list]

The [b]improved Free version[/b] will include (subject to changes):
[list][*] A couple of free unlocked PRO usage days each month (on the 1st and the 15th). Extra days could be added during special periods.
[*] A free PRO version usage the very first time you execute the leaderboard.[/list]

We hope that this news will be well-received by everyone and that it will help us gain more users, more popularity, and [b]more data[/b] on the performance graphs!

notes.title: v1.12 notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved anonymity protection for reviewers with "secret" GPUs. If you have a secret GPU, you will still see your own results and username, but other users won't see either your username or your score, ensuring complete anonymity.
[*] A screenshot is now taken automatically at the end of the benchmark. It is saved in your ...\Documents\GameTechBench Results folder.
[*] Fixed a minor typo that displayed an incorrect benchmark mode name during Raster mode if Path Tracing mode had been previously run.
[/list]
